scientific_integrity: The theorem and inverse characterization follow analytically from exponential renewal ages, Gaussian conditional moments and a Cauchy determinant identity. Symbolic rational examples verify selected instances only. No independent audit or independent literature-priority certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Only finite collections of independent positive-damping real Ornstein–Uhlenbeck coordinates with a shared Poisson zero-reset clock. An arbitrary inverse realization is not automatically an Edwards–Wilkinson Fourier spectrum; nonlinear dynamics and mode-correlated driving are excluded. The forward renewal representation is established prior work.
title: Cauchy rigidity of fourth-order mode correlations under global resetting
